Getting Started

To use the Alpha Vantage API, you need to obtain an API key from our website.

API Endpoints

TIME_SERIES_DAILY

Get daily time series data for stocks.

Parameters:

  • symbol - Stock symbol (required)
  • apikey - Your API key (required)
